column1: ## Radial drift, the fresh seeds (r37b build, seeds 6 to 10): for every body present in two consecutive samples (100 s apart), the change in its distance from the axis, binned by the starting radius. Positive is outward. Averaged over the whole run.

The fully-mixed bound is what a body starting in the bin would drift if its place 100 s later were drawn from the whole crowd (the sample's own mean r, less r0): a stationary disc CANNOT read zero in a bin away from the mean radius, so the bound, not zero, is what a well-mixed world looks like in this statistic. "all radii pooled" is the net flux and is zero at a stationary distribution.
